_comment: Manual test-case inventory this automated suite is expected to cover. Used by the traceability reporter to compute requirements/test-condition coverage — a separate metric from code coverage.

testCases.title: Login form renders in Spanish under ES locale
Register form renders in German under DE locale
Home page audience/calculator/success-story sections render fully in German under DE locale
Favorites-count API does not throw a client-side error for unauthenticated users
Logo alt text, footer copyright, and feature image alt text localize under EN and DE
Payments page subscription-expiry date uses DD.MM.YYYY under DE locale
Payments page prices use comma decimal separator under ES locale
Payments page price-unit suffixes match locale under EN and DE
New user can register with email/password and reach the dashboard with an active trial
Registered user can log in with valid email/password credentials
Login form handles invalid input safely (wrong password, empty submit, malformed email)
Logged-in user can log out and loses access to authenticated pages
"Continue with Google" entry points exist on both register and login
Analytics page renders for an authenticated user
Analytics page triggers repeated resource-load failures (410/404) in console
Below-market page does not localize for EN or DE locale
Offers Dashboard renders for an authenticated user
Interactive Map renders offers for an authenticated user
Top Sales ranking page renders for an authenticated user
Notifications settings page renders for an authenticated user
Favorites page renders pre-seeded sample data and shows the badge count in the nav
Favorites-count badge updates immediately after removing a favorite, without a page reload
Payments page displays all three subscription plans with correct pricing and an accurate active-subscription banner
Payment-method modal echoes the selected plan's name and price
Payment-method modal only allows selecting implemented methods (Stripe); PayPal and Bank Transfer are visibly disabled
Selecting Stripe creates a checkout session and redirects to a valid Stripe-hosted Checkout page
Stripe Checkout defaults to UAH rather than the EUR price shown on the site's pricing page
Switching currency on Stripe Checkout recalculates the amount and updates available payment methods
Stripe Checkout's pre-filled email matches the authenticated user's account email
Closing the payment-method modal cancels cleanly without creating a checkout session
Successful payment via a Stripe test card activates/extends the subscription
A declined/failed card at Stripe Checkout leaves the subscription state unchanged
Abandoning Stripe Checkout mid-session leaves no dangling subscription/charge state
Production Stripe Checkout rejects a well-known Stripe test card number (guards against accidental test-mode misconfiguration)
Terms of Service is reachable without authentication
Protected routes correctly redirect unauthenticated visitors to login
